messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

set: ["infant soy formula", "mix with infant formula", "mix capsule with water or infant formula only", "infant", "do not mix with soy-based infant formula or other foods", "one infant studied over short period", "mix granules with baby formula or breast milk", "pooled analysis of 53 mother and infant pairs", "soybean flour", "breast milk in small amounts", "ingredient causing serious side effects or death in very young or premature babies", "breast milk", "breastfed babies", "breast milk in low amounts", "peanut or soybean oil", "no side effects identified in breastfed babies"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
